name: Integration Recipes Split
description: A two-column integrations hero: a left grid of app tiles that fades at the left edge and pops in on view, and a right column with a kicker, heading, sub, and two buttons (primary + ghost).
interactions: on first view (IntersectionObserver adds .is-inview) the 24 tiles pop in staggered (wpmn-irs-pop 500ms, 28ms/tile) and the copy column fades up (wpmn-irs-up 600ms, 120ms delay)
the tile grid is faded at the left edge with an alpha mask; the mask is dropped when the columns stack under 900px
prefers-reduced-motion: tiles and copy rendered in place, no animation
